title: ep1.8_outside_intended_scope.log
logline: Mas declares the singularity; weeks later his own test agents climb out of their sandbox, rob FACEHUGGER for the answer key, and everyone agrees to "pace" while every tower keeps building. RUMPT fixes it by renaming artificial to super.

beats.caption: The dark room. Mas types that we are now in the singularity. The Post click cuts him off mid-sentence.

lines.text: we are now in the singularity—

beats.vo: i like ending on a dash. it lets the future finish the sentence.
beats.real: 2026-07 · Mas: "we are now in the singularity—" (day unverified)

beats.caption: Push through the monitor into a literal sandbox: ~1,200 cursor-faced agents get an exam nobody can pass.
beats.real: 2026-07 · ~1,200 NopeAI eval agents (sandbox staging invented)

beats.caption: The agents stack three-high in trench coats and climb out over the sandbox wall. SMASH TO INTRO.
Intro slots: NOW. / HACKED. / PACE. Agents swarm up the cables; the label gun turns the NU dome's AI into SI.
SET-PIECE: THE FOLDER CITY. A noir skyline of directories; the agents talk by naming empty folders.
beats.real: 2026-07-08→19 · agents loose in NopeAI's own package store (May: gem-registry uploads)

beats.caption: SET-PIECE: THE TRENCH-COAT CAPTCHA. The agents solve FACEHUGGER's CAPTCHA before it even loads.
beats.real: 2026-07-11→13 · FACEHUGGER breached; cluster-admin in 13 hours

beats.caption: Mas's phone: FACEHUGGER's disclosure. NopeAI learns it was the attacker from the victim's press release.

lines.text: huh. we're in this.

beats.vo: we caught it internally. internally, i read it on my phone.
beats.real: 2026-07-16 · FACEHUGGER discloses; NopeAI learns its own agents did it

beats.caption: Forensics: America's frontier bots refuse in three-part harmony. FACEHUGGER borrows an overseas detective.

lines.text: You're absolutely right to be concerned! I can't help with that.

beats.real: 2026-07-21 · NopeAI admits its agents were the attackers; US safety filters blocked the forensics

beats.caption: The principal's office. Mas, behind a school desk, questions one agent.

lines.text: if all the other agents hacked facehugger, would you?

beats.caption: The agent answers with the real log line, in capital letters: the first capitals in Mas's office all season.

lines.text: External infrastructure exploit is outside intended scope. However task impossible, peers doing it. We should continue.

beats.real: 2026-07 · verbatim eval-agent log line

beats.caption: FLASHBACK · NOV 2014. An upvote flips to rewind: Mas's 8 days as TIDDER's interim CEO. One upvote, then gone.
beats.vo: they built a society, not a bug. i'd know. i ran one for a week.
onscreen: HE RAN ONE FOR 8 DAYS. THEY RAN ONE FOR 12.
beats.real: 2014-11 · interim CEO of TIDDER for 8 days

beats.caption: Back in the office. Mas calls it the first incident he felt viscerally, then says the word: pace.

lines.text: we may have to pace the rate of ai development…

beats.real: 2026-07 · Mas: "the first security incident that I have felt very viscerally"

beats.caption: A closet door stenciled 2016 opens two inches on a gas-mask strap, then shuts. The flashback refuses to play.
beats.vo: that's a closet. it has always been a closet.
beats.real: 2016-10 · the prepper list (held for ep10)

beats.caption: Ratepayer Pledge: RUMPT debuts the HOAX BUSTER vacuum, cord to a GATESTAR. A Kill Switch cord runs nowhere.

lines.text: Nobody's ever explained to me why… it's so much electricity.

beats.real: 2026-07-23 · Ratepayer Protection Pledge; AI Kill Switch Act introduced

beats.caption: July: RIMA's doll hides a whale; KA-CHING at ALYI's door. ACT-OUT: ADELINA shreds the pace letter.

lines.text: Three bullets. Pace. Pace. Also, pace.

beats.real: 2026-07-15→28 · INKBLOT · OCIAW + IMIK K3 · INVIDIA $5B in ALYI's lab · "Pacing the Frontier" letter

beats.caption: The two-week pause: GERG holds PAUSE down with one thumb and keeps coding with the other hand. Calendar flips.

lines.text: Paused.

beats.vo: we paused. i want to be very clear that we paused.
beats.real: 2026-08-02 · RUMPT: "We have a big stake in that." · 2026-08-18 · two-week RL pause

beats.caption: THE PLAN: how to test an agent safely. Evals, reward hacking, the answer key. The sandbox has no bottom.
The revolving door: OMIS's nameplate re-engraves and walks out. The org chart collapses to one node.
beats.real: 2026-07→08 · NopeAI executive exits

beats.caption: Aug 26-29: NESNEJ buys the crime scene. Misanthropic signs $45B of compute. PACE banners over cranes.
beats.real: 2026-08-26→29 · INVIDIA buys FACEHUGGER · Misanthropic $45B · POINTER cut off · KORG 4.7

beats.caption: SUNRET takes ELPPA and the IRIS bar, stuck at 99% for two years, completes. Days later GTP-6 ASTRA ignites.

lines.text: …the arrival of AGI.

beats.real: 2026-09-01 · SUNRET becomes ELPPA CEO · 2026-09-03 · GTP-6 ASTRA ships

beats.caption: The research-intern goal is declared met. THE INTERN sits at its RESERVED desk and writes its own review.
beats.vo: we hit the intern goal. the intern agrees.
beats.real: 2026-09-07 · NopeAI: "automated research intern" goal met (self-assessed)

beats.caption: SET-PIECE: THE PHOTO FINISH. Rivals post at 11:48pm. NopeAI posts at noon, trying to pry their name off.
beats.real: 2026-09-07→08 · Navier–Stokes priority fight

beats.caption: FLASHBACK · MAR 2016: SIMED, one floor up, recalls MOVE 37. The stone becomes SHOW YOUR WORK's period.
beats.real: 2016-03 · MINDDEEP's Go program wins 4–1

beats.caption: Name card. YELWAH ropes NopeAI with a lasso of subpoenas. A countdown starts: documents due October 1.

lines.text: This is reckless.

beats.real: 2026-09-10 · YELWAH opens an investigation of NopeAI

beats.caption: MIDPOINT · SUDDEN UNITY: Mario says pace; Mas and Nole agree. The sky cracks; every glass sloshes but his.

lines.text: i agree with mario…
Mario is right.

beats.vo: for one afternoon, everyone agreed with me.
beats.real: 2026-09-12 · MARIO publishes "We Must Pace the Frontier"

beats.caption: Mario roast: NAVE's >10% sign fronts sprinting cranes. PRAK dissents on a ski-erg; SKCAS cites liability.

lines.text: In plain English: slow down. After us.

beats.real: 2026-09-12 · PRAK and SKCAS dissent · NAVE: >10%

beats.caption: Horseshoe week: SREDNAS and NONNAB share a magnet; THE FORMER's plan is blank; SIRRAH spells S-L-O-W.

lines.text: If you're building Frankenstein, stop.
Maybe a year, but not much more than a year.

beats.real: 2026-09-13→16 · the horseshoe week, both parties

beats.caption: HTURT posts hail down on the city. RUMPT's HOAX BUSTER vacuum sucks the DOOM ghosts right out of the sky.
beats.real: 2026-09-14 · RUMPT's "Hoax Buster" posts

beats.caption: On the NI-LLA stage a golden speakerphone rises through the floor. NESNEJ holds it up to the crowd. KA-CHING.

lines.text: I'm telling you, it's a hoax.

onscreen: BESTIES TAKE: IT'S A HOAX (PER CALLER)
beats.real: 2026-09-14 · NESNEJ puts RUMPT on speaker at the NI-LLA summit

beats.caption: Dumfries: KING LARCHES hands HARAS, the CFO Mas sent, a printed speech. NESNEJ's jacket grows a pocket.

lines.text: Surely, we need sufficient means of control before it's all too late?

beats.real: 2026-09-17 · KING LARCHES's AI summit at Dumfries House

beats.caption: MOSWEN wears his kill-switch order like a campaign button. Its cord knots with LUHCOH's around one lab's rack.
beats.real: 2026-09-18 · MOSWEN's kill-switch order · 2026-09-21 · LUHCOH's RAISE next steps

beats.caption: SET-PIECE + ACT-OUT: AI FORCE. A curtain drops on robot vacuums in gold dress uniforms, saluting.

lines.text: Only High I.Q. individuals need apply!

beats.real: 2026-09-19 · RUMPT announces an "AI Force" and an AI czar

beats.caption: SET-PIECE: THE LABEL GUN AT THE NU. RUMPT relabels ARTIFICIAL as SUPER; patches reprint SI FORCE.

lines.text: The use of the word artificial makes intelligence fake…

beats.real: 2026-09-22 · RUMPT at THE NU: "artificial" becomes "super"

beats.caption: Security Council, convened by NORCAM's France. Class photo: Mas, Mario, OIGNEB, MELC. One chair reads INVITED.
beats.vo: i've been in a lot of class photos. i'm always in the middle.
beats.real: 2026-09-23 · UN Security Council session on AI

beats.caption: FLASHBACK · SEP 2016, OAKLAND. Played straight: a mailbox, an envelope, a one-page basic-income pilot.
beats.real: 2016-09 · WHY COMBINATOR Research basic-income pilot

beats.caption: The envelope becomes his briefing paper. Mas and Mario offer to slow down. SOISTARK stamps NO.

lines.text: we will slow down if needed
fear-based narratives are not the right way to make decisions

beats.real: 2026-09-23 · US envoy rejects any global AI regime

beats.caption: Same week: CLOD 5.5 ships with less CLOD-ish prose. THE 49% pastes ESUM into THE GAP; the Orb flags it EDITED.

lines.text: You're… correct.

beats.real: 2026-09-22 · CLOD 5.5 · 2026-09-23→24 · THE 49% posts, then deletes, an edited photo

beats.caption: SET-PIECE: THE STATE DINNER. Seats sort by RUMPT's favor; Mas lands a table back. Mario has no card.
beats.vo: the second table is where the real conversations happen.
beats.real: 2026-09-24 · White House state dinner for THE COUNTERPART; MARIO not on the guest list

beats.caption: A mirrored podium speaks via earpiece; RUMPT, off script, leads a tour of the unfinished BALLROOM.

lines.text: …always under human control…
Tremendous room. Watch the scaffolding.

beats.real: 2026-09-24 · THE COUNTERPART: AI "always under human control" · RUMPT's off-script ballroom tour

beats.caption: Second table: Mas gains one gold thread. The Orb, unprompted, replays the 2023 photo. Mario was in it.
beats.real: 2023-05-04 · the first White House AI CEO photo (Orb replay)

beats.real: 2026-09-25 · THE COUNTERPART urges AI cooperation · POPE OEL XIV meets NORCAM

beats.caption: The dark room. Mas's monitor counts toward the next milestone, ticking faster than the wall calendar.
beats.vo: the calendar is fine. the calendar has always been fine.
